headline: Front Lines Shift Across Six Active Sectors
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the war’s ownership struggle still concentrated in a handful of unsettled sectors, with several fronts changing character since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse has become the busiest watch, rising to 54 base events in 24 hours and recording seven in the latest two-hour window; four Warden, one Colonial, and four neutral bases now mark its fluid line. Marban Hollow has quickened to 24 daily events, including five in the last two hours, while its count stands at two Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Linn Mercy has climbed to 22 events and now lists ten Colonial, no Warden, and one neutral base, a marked change in the reported balance. Nevish Line has cooled from its earlier bustle to 27 events, though two were recent and its eight Warden bases are no longer accompanied by a neutral holding. Mooring County shows eight events, four in the latest watch, amid twelve Warden bases. Kuura Strand has eased to seven daily events, but the latest movement remains recent. Elsewhere, heavy fighting continues in several sectors without recorded base events.
